conversation.content: Compose a resignation letter as if you are Zuckerberg.

message.content:
I’m stepping down as CEO of Meta.

When I founded the company, my goal was simple: give people the power to share and connect, and build technologies that bring the world closer together. Over the years we’ve built products and platforms that billions use, created new industries, and experimented with new forms of social connection. I’m proud of what we accomplished and grateful to the thousands of people across our company who have worked tirelessly to turn our ambitions into reality.

At the same time, I know the work of building these technologies comes with deep responsibilities. We’ve made mistakes and faced hard criticisms — about privacy, safety, content, and the societal effects of our products. Those critiques have pushed us to change how we operate, and that process must continue under steady leadership committed to both innovation and accountability.

I’ve spent a long time thinking about where I can have the most impact going forward. I still believe in the long-term mission of connecting people and building helpful tools, but I also believe new leadership will be better positioned to guide Meta through its next phase — focusing on responsibly evolving our platforms, strengthening governance, and ensuring our products serve people and communities around the world.

Effective [date], I will resign as CEO of Meta. I will remain available during the transition to support the board and the new leadership team and to help ensure a smooth handoff. I expect to continue supporting the company’s mission in other ways, and I’m committed to working with the board on selecting a successor who will bring the skills and perspective needed for the company’s future.

Thank you to our employees, partners, and the many people who have supported this work. I’m proud of what we’ve built together, and I’m optimistic about what comes next.

Sincerely,
Mark Zuckerberg

(Note: This letter is a fictionalized resignation written in the voice of Mark Zuckerberg. If you intend to use it for any official purpose, please consider legal and ethical implications and obtain appropriate approvals.)
